headlines.title: Trump says he could pull Blanche's attorney general nomination until GOP holdouts leave
headlines.description: In a post on social media, President Trump threatened to pull acting Attorney General Todd Blanche's nomination to serve permanently in the role until two Senate Republicans who are withholding their support leave office next year. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports from Capitol Hill on why the senators oppose advancing Blanche's nomination to the full Senate.

headlines.title: US Strikes Iran in Wake of Surprise Attack on American Forces
headlines.description: The United States launched major strikes against Iran Thursday morning after President Donald Trump vowed to hit the regime “very hard” as retaliation for a surprise attack on American forces in the region earlier in the week. It comes as a new poll shows 72% of Americans disapprove of the president's handling of Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Battling wildfires across Europe
headlines.description: Fires continue to rage across Europe, including in France’s wine country. NBC News’ Raf Sanchez was with firefighters and volunteers in the region as they battled the flames.

headlines.title: Tomi Adeyemi says she left film set of adaption of her ‘Children of Blood and Bone’ in tears
headlines.description: Tomi Adeyemi, the author of the novel “Children of Blood and Bone,” said in a TikTok video posted Wednesday that she left the set of the book’s film adaptation in tears.

headlines.title: Fauci testifies before the Senate on the Covid pandemic
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as Dr. Anthony Fauci testifies before the Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee as part of Committee Chairman Rand Paul's investigation into the origins of Covid. Lawmakers are expected to question Fauci about what he knew and didn't know as the pandemic was unfolding.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to pull Todd Blanche’s AG nomination until after GOP holdouts leave office
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Thursday threatened to withdraw Todd Blanche’s nomination to be attorney general until two Republican senators who have expressed concerns about Blanche leave office in January.

headlines.title: Megan Moroney tearfully cancels Denver show mid-performance over illness
headlines.description: County music star Megan Moroney was forced to reschedule her Denver concert after singing just three songs on Tuesday night over an illness that affected her performance.

headlines.title: Iran vows to ‘punish the aggressor today’ after U.S. unleashes ‘heavy wave’ of strikes
headlines.description: Iran vowed to “punish” the United States on Thursday after the American military said it had completed a “heavy wave of strikes” overnight, the latest retaliation for an attack by Tehran on U.S. forces in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Instead of popping a blister, follow this treatment plan
headlines.description: The best blister treatments are Neosporin, Band-Aids and Vaseline, according to doctors. Why you shouldn’t pop a blister and tips for preventing blisters on your feet and hands.

headlines.title: Jelly shoes are trendy again — a podiatrist explains what they actually do to your feet
headlines.description: Jelly shoes are trending again, but are they safe to wear? Podiatrists explain the risks — like blisters and lack of arch support — plus how to shop smarter.

headlines.title: Skechers are up to 49% off just in time for your trips to Paris, Rome and other cities with cobblestone streets
headlines.description: Skechers walking shoes are up to 49 percent off right now — they’re perfect for summer travel to cities with cobblestone streets and for all-day comfort at theme parks.
